Name: Alternate Abby Outfit
Author: scoodii
Description:
I just wanted something a little different for Abby to wear, so this is a more goth-y outfit. It includes both a change to her sprites and her portrait.
Not compatible with any other mods that replace Abigail.xnb.

[u]Instructions:[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Backup Abigail.xnb located in Content\Characters and Abigail.xnb in Content\Portraits. These are two different files, so keep them separate.
[*]Overwrite the original files with the files from this mod. Again, they have the same name but are two different files, so work with them separately.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]

Downloads.Description: A more goth-inspired outfit for Abby.
